fields.Name: T092 - Entity Form Edit-Mode Dirty Field Banner
fields.Description: Tests the live dirty-field-tracking banner (DirtyFieldDisplayNames count + names, ShowEditBanner) — distinct from the edit-and-save round-trips (T201-T209) and from discard (T204); the observable here is the real-time change-tracking display, not persistence.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Events' entity via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box, click an event row, then 'Open Full Record'. Click Edit to enter edit mode — an edit banner appears at the top. Modify one editable text field (e.g. Location or Description) to a new value. Confirm the banner updates to show a count of modified fields (e.g. '1 field modified') and lists the changed field name(s). Success is the banner reflecting the dirty-field count/name after your edit — you do NOT need to save. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Entering edit mode shows an edit banner with Save/Discard actions
After editing a field, the banner reports the number of modified fields and/or names the changed field
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
